title: Preflight compose budget before reference execution
finding: The plan-wide operation budget was cumulative after G1-TENSOR-01AW, but Compose still entered TypedRelationBlock.matmul before the interpreter knew the exact CSR multiplication cost. An over-budget composition therefore performed bounded partial semiring work and result-map mutation before refusing, even though the exact operation count is derivable cheaply from the already validated CSR row offsets and left column indices.
primary_claim: ReferenceContractionInterpreter now computes the exact Compose operation count before invoking matmul and refuses immediately when it exceeds the remaining plan-wide budget. Accepted compositions retain the same canonical TypedRelationBlock result and the existing block-level max_operations guard remains as a local defense in depth.
gardener_decision: Reuse the existing CSR structure to derive the exact reference cost before execution rather than adding a planner, cost model, receipt type, or backend abstraction. The change moves the already-required operation accounting ahead of expensive semiring work and keeps the executable oracle small.
acceptance: a single Compose whose exact cost exceeds the remaining plan budget refuses before TypedRelationBlock.matmul is invoked
a multi-node plan still consumes one cumulative max_operations budget across compositions
accepted Compose results retain the existing revision, signature, axes, semiring and canonical entry semantics
the local TypedRelationBlock matmul operation limit remains unchanged
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

requested: bounded Tensor/Forest diagnostic on the designated Python 3.12 hash-seed 0 cell
verification.claim: Only exact-head executed workflow steps count as evidence.

rollback: Revert the G1-TENSOR-01AY commits; Forest/Fourfold authority, relation-block wire contracts, semiring semantics and persisted identities are unchanged.
